#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -e
source /workspace/work/engine-goal-20261112/build.env
cd /workspace/Nexora-delivery-773
out=/workspace/work/engine-goal-20261112/authoring
trap 'printf "%s\n" "$?" > "$out/source-reload-generation-native-context-all-gates.exit"' EXIT
printf "%s\n" running > "$out/source-reload-generation-native-context-all-gates.exit"
run_gate() {
  local label="$1"
  shift
  printf '%s\n' "$label" > "$out/source-reload-generation-native-context-current-gate"
  local result=0
  "$@" > "$out/$label.log" 2>&1 || result=$?
  printf '%s\n' "$result" > "$out/$label.exit"
  return "$result"
}

run_gate source-reload-generation-native-context-shipping-build cmake --build --preset linux-shipping
run_gate source-reload-generation-native-context-shipping-native python3 Tests/TwoD/SpriteSourcePlayerAcceptance.py --app /workspace/Nexora-delivery-773/build/linux-shipping/Apps/TwoDPlayer/NexoraTwoDPlayer --zig /workspace/work/engine-goal-20261112/tools/lib/python3.12/site-packages/ziglang/zig --cmake /workspace/work/engine-goal-20261112/tools/lib/python3.12/site-packages/cmake/data/bin/cmake --compiler /workspace/Nexora-delivery-773/build/linux-development/Tools/TwoD/NexoraTwoDAssetCompiler --catalog --animation --native --shipping --evidence-dir /workspace/Nexora-delivery-773/build/linux-shipping/artifacts/source-animation-player
run_gate source-reload-generation-native-context-monolithic-configure cmake --preset linux-development -B build/source-reload-monolithic -DNEXORA_LINK_MODE=Monolithic -DNEXORA_ENABLE_2D=ON -DNEXORA_ENABLE_EDITOR_GRAPHICAL_SHELL=ON -DNEXORA_ENABLE_SLANG=OFF -DNEXORA_ENABLE_ZIG_GAMEPLAY=OFF
run_gate source-reload-generation-native-context-monolithic-build cmake --build build/source-reload-monolithic --target NexoraGameplayGenerationTests NexoraSourceAnimationTests NexoraTwoDPlayAssetTests NexoraTwoDAuthoringTests NexoraTwoDPanelTests
run_gate source-reload-generation-native-context-monolithic-test ctest --test-dir build/source-reload-monolithic -R '^twod\.(gameplay_generation|source_animation|play_assets|authoring_contracts|graphical_controls)$' --output-on-failure
run_gate source-reload-generation-native-context-feature-off-configure cmake --preset linux-development -B build/source-reload-feature-off -DNEXORA_ENABLE_2D=OFF -DBUILD_TESTING=OFF -DNEXORA_ENABLE_EDITOR_GRAPHICAL_SHELL=ON -DNEXORA_ENABLE_SLANG=OFF -DNEXORA_ENABLE_ZIG_GAMEPLAY=OFF -DNEXORA_BUILD_PROJECT_PLAYER=ON -DNEXORA_ENABLE_PROJECT_PLAYER_NATIVE=ON
run_gate source-reload-generation-native-context-feature-off-build cmake --build build/source-reload-feature-off --target NexoraEditor NexoraProjectPlayer
printf '%s\n' complete > "$out/source-reload-generation-native-context-current-gate"
